nodes.label: Gold Table In Databricks
nodes.rationale: Screenshot of the notebook's final cell: gold.write.mode('overwrite').saveAsTable(gold_port_product_volume) and the rendered result. A 15-row table keyed by port and product (DKFRC/VLSFO, AEFJR/HSFO, SGSIN/LSMGO...) with trades, total_mt, total_usd and avg_price_usd_per_mt columns, sorted by value. Evidence that the notebook produces a real Delta table from the committed sample, not a mock-up.
